Footer.privacyContent:
1. Data Controller

The controller of your personal data is Evoliq s.r.o., registered office at [address], ID: [ID].

2. What Data We Process

We process the following categories of personal data:

  • Identification data (name, surname, email, phone)
  • Data on the use of our services
  • Cookies and other analytical data

3. Purpose of Processing

We process your personal data for the purpose of:

  • Providing our services and products
  • Communicating with you regarding our services
  • Improving the quality of our services
  • Fulfilling legal obligations

4. Legal Basis for Processing

We process data based on:

  • Your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR)
  • Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR)
  • Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR)

5. Retention Period

We retain personal data for the period necessary to fulfill the purpose of processing, but at least for the period required by legal regulations.

6. Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict processing, transfer data, and object. If you have any questions, contact us at [contact email].
Footer.gdprContent:
General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)

GDPR is an EU regulation on personal data protection that came into force on May 25, 2018. It ensures uniform rules for personal data protection across the European Union.

Your Rights under GDPR:

  • Right of Access: You have the right to obtain information about what personal data we process about you.
  • Right to Rectification: You have the right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
  • Right to Erasure: You can request the deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten").
  • Right to Restriction of Processing: You can request restriction of processing of your data.
  • Right to Portability: You have the right to obtain your data in a structured, commonly used format.
  • Right to Object: You can object to the processing of your data.
  • Right to Withdraw Consent: If processing is based on consent, you can withdraw it at any time.

How to Exercise Your Rights:

To exercise your rights, contact us at email: [contact email]

We will respond without undue delay, no later than 1 month after receiving the request.

Complaint to Supervisory Authority:

You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Office for Personal Data Protection (www.uoou.cz) if you believe that the processing of your personal data violates GDPR.

UnflattenW.metadataTitle: Unflatten W Dense 1.0 — local PDF to Word | Evoliq Labs
UnflattenW.metadataDescription: Download Unflatten W Dense 1.0 and its local application to reconstruct PDF pages and document images into editable Word. A released research candidate; review output text and layout.
UnflattenW.title: Unflatten W Dense 1.0
UnflattenW.subtitle: From PDF and document images to editable DOCX
UnflattenW.intro: Unflatten W Dense 1.0 is an Evoliq Labs research candidate for reconstructing PDF pages and document images into structured, editable Word documents. The public model runs through a dedicated local application; generated documents require review.
UnflattenW.inputDesc: Scanned documents, reports, contracts and forms
UnflattenW.familyIntro: Unflatten W Dense 1.0 is publicly released as a research candidate for Word documents. X for spreadsheets, P for presentations and Forms for structured, editable forms are planned. MoE remains a research direction.
UnflattenW.sharedDesc: Layout understanding, structured decoding and model research
UnflattenW.xDesc: Documents and tables → structured spreadsheet output
UnflattenW.pDesc: Slides and visual layouts → editable presentation structure
UnflattenW.formsDesc: PDF / document images → structured, editable forms
features: Reconstructs paragraphs, headings, lists, sections and document structure.
Reconstructs table structure and cell properties.
Reconstructs image placement and document resources.
Dense 1.0 is a released research candidate. MoE remains a research direction.
UnflattenW.familyVisualText: The Unflatten family brings together W for Word and the planned X, P and Forms directions for spreadsheets, presentations and structured, editable forms.
UnflattenW.architectureText: Dense 1.0 combines the frozen Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct backbone with trained document-reconstruction modules and typed property heads. The local runtime uses BF16 and constrained document decoding. A deterministic renderer converts the validated Canonical AST into DOCX; valid structure does not guarantee correct text or layout.
UnflattenW.architectureVisualsIntro: The diagrams introduce the Dense architecture and the separate MoE research direction. See the release guide for the distributed Dense 1.0 runtime and its limitations.

UnflattenW.denseVisualAlt: Architecture overview of the Unflatten Dense model, with English and Slovak labels.
UnflattenW.moeVisualCaption: Research preview of the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture. Diagram labels are in English.
UnflattenW.moeVisualAlt: English-language architecture diagram for Unflatten MoE, shown as a research preview.
UnflattenW.statusText: Unflatten W Dense 1.0 and its local application are publicly available as a research release. X, P and Forms are planned, while MoE remains a research direction.
UnflattenW.ogAlt: Evoliq Labs — Unflatten W Dense 1.0 research candidate for local document reconstruction

UnflattenRelease.title: Download and run locally
UnflattenRelease.intro: The public Dense 1.0 research release includes a document reconstruction model and a dedicated local application for PDF and image conversion to editable Word.
UnflattenRelease.modelLink: Download the model on Hugging Face
UnflattenRelease.toolLink: Get the local application on GitHub
UnflattenRelease.docsLink: Read the setup and API documentation
UnflattenRelease.quickstartText: Clone or extract the application repository and run ./Start.sh. The launcher automatically downloads, verifies and prepares the public model; no Hugging Face account or token is needed. Create a local password, upload PDF, PNG or JPEG, follow the job progress and download Word. The application interface is available in Slovak and English.
requirements: Linux, Docker Engine with the Compose plugin, NVIDIA Container Toolkit and an NVIDIA driver compatible with the runtime's CUDA 13.
An NVIDIA CUDA GPU; at least 16 GB of GPU memory is recommended for the distributed BF16 model. Available memory and other GPU workloads affect whether it fits.
About 11 GB for the downloaded model, plus space for containers and documents. The first build and model download require internet access.
UnflattenRelease.apiText: Use a Bearer API token to upload a document, poll its job status and download the Word result. This token is separate from the application password and any Hugging Face download token. Swagger and OpenAPI are served by your local installation. The repository's API guide documents authentication, requests and a Python client for conversion without the application interface.
UnflattenRelease.licenseText: EVOLIQ's original contributions are free for an individual's private, noncommercial use under the EVOLIQ Personal Use and Commercial License 1.0. Business use, internal organizational use, professional or client work, product integration and hosted services require a separate paid written agreement with EVOLIQ s.r.o. before use. Third-party components retain their own licences, including Apache 2.0 for the Qwen backbone.
UnflattenRelease.evaluationIntro: Dense 1.0 was compared on the same 100 fixed validation pages using the same decoding setup. The text-tolerance criterion is a normalized character error rate ≤ 2%. The release notes explain the text normalization; 90 / 100 is a page-level pass rate.
evaluationRows: Pages passing the configured text-tolerance test
UnflattenRelease.evaluationNote: Producing a Word file measures diagnostic output, not visual fidelity or 99% accuracy. These are validation results, not an independent benchmark or evidence of production quality. Compared with the parent model, one more page passed the text-tolerance test and one more Word file was produced, while aggregate text errors were slightly higher.
limitations: Each model call accepts one raster page. The application coordinates the pages of a multipage PDF.
Text, reading order, layout, tables and image placement can contain errors. Review the generated document before relying on it.
CUDA inference was verified on NVIDIA DGX Spark. Other platforms and fresh installations need their own validation.
The distributed model uses BF16. A separate experimental FP8 test bundle is not distributed with this release.
